name: China's 10th Anniversary Championship 2017

venue.name: Guangzhou Yihe Hotel

information:
From 2007/10/01 to 2017/10/01, WCA competitions in China have passed 10 years and been spreading across the mainland. 
Let's celebrate our big days for the 10th anniversary!
Please check the competition website for details and registration.
